purpose: Calibrated diffraction-evidence tiers for 188 bibliography-supported RRUFF candidate groups.
important_note: These tiers annotate evidence strength. They do not automatically collapse a candidate group to a unique ground-truth CIF.

tier_definition_notes.high_diffraction_support: Cu-like; core three absolute metrics inside empirical P95; best-runner separation >0.10 deg; unique diffraction Pareto candidate; best candidate lies on cell Pareto front.
tier_definition_notes.moderate_diffraction_support: Same as high support through unique diffraction Pareto status, but without cell-Pareto concordance.
tier_definition_notes.limited_diffraction_support: Absolute compatibility and >0.10 deg separability, but diffraction Pareto front remains non-unique.
tier_definition_notes.poor_absolute_compatibility: Best candidate falls outside the descriptive empirical P95 envelope on at least one core metric.
tier_definition_notes.sparse_calibration: Same-radiation calibration support is sparse; currently applies to Mo-like groups.
